LongTermMemoryConfigInput.description:
Long-term memory configuration.

On Redis Cloud, `llm` and `embedding` select the store's own models and must be
supplied together; `classification` is independent. Omit them to use the platform
models. The embedding model cannot be changed after the store is created.

sessionSummaryEnabled.description:
Extract session summaries into long-term memory. Takes effect only when the
deployment enables session summary extraction.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for long-term memory entries. Defaults to 1 year.

LongTermMemoryConfigStatus.description:
Long-term memory configuration. On Redis Cloud, `embedding`, `llm`, and
`classification` are present only when the store selected its own models.

sessionSummaryEnabled.description: Whether session summary extraction into long-term memory is enabled for this store.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for long-term memory entries.

LongTermMemoryConfigUpdate.description:
Long-term memory configuration. Omitted fields keep their current value.

On Redis Cloud:
- `embedding`: only the credential can be replaced.
- `llm`: the model can be changed within the same provider, and the credential
  replaced.
- `classification`: same as `llm`. A store without a classification model may
  select one.

A store created with the platform models cannot switch `embedding` or `llm` to its
own models.
